1563-2457-4885-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

578-7500.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three artifact cards in hand.
578-7500.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, revealing at least three artifact cards from your hand and adding at least six {C}.
Activate Ringing Strike Mastery by paying {5}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

413-891-1703.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fool's Demise's first and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise ability, doing nothing,.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

423-573-1437-3177--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-573-1437-3177--85.description:
Cast Sakura-Tribe Scout by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Sakura-Tribe Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Sakura-Tribe Scout copy.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

6249-6798-7256--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
6249-6798-7256--5.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Warhost's Frenzy trigger.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2

628-2438-7218.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reaping Willow.
When Reaping Willow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

3991-4605-5147-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3771-7182-7252.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
3771-7182-7252.description:
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Warden of the Eye

64-1692-2489-3732.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
64-1692-2489-3732.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
64-1692-2489-3732.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye with haste.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

585-4231-4508-5880.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure, Food and Clue token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2544-4893-6784.description:
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Steelswarm Operator.
Repeat.
2544-4893-6784.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can either use Steelswarm Operator's first ability or untap other artifacts you control.

2866-4779-4986-5034.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sol Ring.
When Sol Ring leaves the battlefield, Scrap Trawler triggers, returning any mana value 0 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

56-4976-5075-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-4976-5075-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Ogre Slumlord and Open the Graves trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-4976-5075-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

1274-1496-2034-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1496-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1636-4147-5911--57.notablePrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
One of the creatures with mana value 0 must be in your hand, with the other being in your graveyard.
You have no other cards in hand.
1636-4147-5911--57.description:
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the 0 mana value creature from your graveyard on top of your library.
Cast the 0 mana value creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Flubs triggers, causing you to draw the 0 mana value creature that was put on top of your library.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 2, causing the creature to enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2084-5400.notablePrerequisites: Synth Infiltrator is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-5400.description: Activate Synth Infiltrator by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Synth Infiltrator into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

5544-5670-5708.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
5544-5670-5708.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Vein Ripper triggers, targeting an opponent.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Vein Ripper ability, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

250-2573-3946.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability and The Gitrog Monster's first ability trigger.
Resolve The Gitrog Monster trigger, sacrificing Glacial Chasm.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, choosing not to pay and doing nothing as Glacial Chasm is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

147-2438-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2438-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2438-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

859-4702-4716.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Lurking Roper.
859-4702-4716.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.

423-511-3510-4429.notablePrerequisites: Either Sporoloth Ancient or Thallid has at least three spore counters on it, with the other having at least two spore counters on it.
423-511-3510-4429.description:
Activate either Thallid or Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Life and Limb, Evolution Sage triggers, putting a spore counter on Thallid and Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.

283-890-2722-4241.notablePrerequisites: Magewright's Stone and Palladium Myr do not have summoning sickness.
283-890-2722-4241.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Magewright's Stone to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Illusionist's Bracers' equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to Magewright's Stone.
Activate Magewright's Stone by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Magewright's Stone abillity, targeting Palladium Myr.
Resolve both Magewright's Stone abilities, untapping Magewright's Stone and Palladium Myr.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4.

1881-1947-5220.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Reckless Barbarian dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Reckless Barbarian on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Reckless Barbarian from the top of your library by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

751-855-2060-2854.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
751-855-2060-2854.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {U}.
Shrieking Drake triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

1330-2615-4150.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
1330-2615-4150.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Shivan Meteor for {3}{R}{R}, dealing thirteen damage to Truefire Captain.
Truefire Captain triggers, dealing 20 damage to target opponent.
